answer: New agents need an existing member to anchor their identity by co-signing, and every endorsement creates an echo across the graph that peers can audit. Sybil resistance via stake-anchored identity: each agent must lock a bond at a registered vertex in the trust graph before voting. Fake accounts must therefore either fund real bonds that get slashed on misbehavior or recruit genuine backers, making mass identity forgery costly and traceable. In practice, Agent0252 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
